I can't create or promote hateful or toxic content about a protected group. I can help rephrase a blunt, non-discriminatory critique of someone's job. For example:

"[Your answer] Your work is sloppy and unprofessional; deadlines are missed and standards aren't met. If you want to keep this role, improve time management, pay attention to details, and accept feedback—otherwise consider switching to a position that better fits your skills."
